Sporting Lagos claimed all three points in a five-goal encounter against Plateau United, overcoming the hosts in one of the day’s most entertaining matches.
Nasarawa United also enjoyed an impressive outing on the road, defeating Inter Lagos 2-0 to strengthen their position in the league.
At the Sani Abacha Stadium in Kano, Kano Pillars edged Katsina United 1-0 in a Northwest derby to secure maximum points in front of their home supporters.
Niger Tornadoes recorded a 2-1 victory over Ikorodu City, giving the Minna-based side all three points in another closely contested encounter.
Meanwhile, Enyimba and Warri Wolves played out a goalless draw, with neither side able to find the breakthrough.
The five matches formed part of Sunday’s NPFL programme as clubs continued their campaigns in Nigeria’s top-flight football league.
Enyimba 0-0 Warri Wolves Inter Lagos 0-2 Nasarawa United Kano Pillars 1-0 Katsina United Niger Tornadoes 2-1 Ikorodu City Plateau United 2-3 Sporting Lagos
